description:
## Why This Exists

search/mod.rs::build_schema() returns (Schema, Fields) as separate values. If the schema is later mutated or re-created, the Fields struct still holds stale Field handles from the original schema. The current code does not mutate the schema, but the separation is fragile: a future refactor that calls build_schema() twice would produce two Schema objects with Fields that silently cross-reference the wrong schema.

## Acceptance Criteria

Return a single struct (e.g. SchemaWithFields) that wraps both. This prevents callers from accidentally using Fields from schema A with schema B.
title: Rust idiom: search/mod.rs::build_schema returns Fields separately, breaking schema/fields sync
